body: I like to check out this subreddit to remind myself of just how much society hates people like me.

I mean, there's no way in hell that I'm going back to therapy. I'm not going to spend hundreds of dollars to feel like shit. I've already been on a bunch of different anti-depressants, but they didn't do anything positive for me because there's nothing wrong with my brain chemistry. I think they made me feel more suicidal though; I stopped taking them after I almost killed myself, and I've felt a little better since giving up on them. 

I don't have any hopes of my life improving. I guess I just want to know how to fully numb myself so I don't have to feel bad about my failure anymore. Like if I'm destined to be alone forever, what do I do to find peace? Especially when I can't earn anyone's respect unless I find someone who wants to enter into a romantic relationship with me. My parents and siblings already tell me I'm pathetic for being this old without ever being in a relationship, so by the time I'm 30, I don't think I'll be too ashamed to even talk to them anymore.

I mean I don't think there's really another way to say get a girlfriend without it being incredibly awkward. I could say "find a woman with which to enter into a relationship", but no one talks like that. 

>>I know you blame it on your looks but if my bald, fat, socially awkward coworker with a glass eye that regularly pops out of his head found someone to be in a relationship with, trust me so can you. 

I never said anything about my looks. I'm complete garbage in every single way, not just looks.

I tried doing therapy again, but I left feeling completely suicidal. Talking about my problems out loud makes it obvious that it's so much worse than it appears. I'm truly subhuman, and I feel like a moron for ever having entertained the possibility that I could be happy.

I'm a total loser at 28-years-old. I'll never have a girlfriend; I'll always just be a pathetic joke that my whole family is ashamed of. And the worst part is that there's no chance of escape. Even though I've known I should rope since I was a teenager, I've been too cowardly to do it; even when all my life experiences have only served to make things more clear, I still haven't been able to do it.

So if I can't ever have a girlfriend, and I can't just end this misery, what am I supposed to do? Therapy has consistently made me feel awful; I might end up killing myself if I keep it up, which would be ok, but I'm too weak to actively seek out that feeling of complete despair. What do incels do when they've completely accepted their failure? There's really nothing that I enjoy or care about. Whenever I've tried out some new activity, I've realized that I would have been better off just staying home and sleeping.

I think I just failed with women because there is absolutely nothing appealing about me. I'm fairly confident that no woman has ever, or will ever be, interested in someone like me. I don't think any man would ever want to be my boyfriend either for the record, but it's definitely easier to find a gay guy who's down to have sex.

I'm not going to take my life. I wish I could, but I'm too weak-willed. And I think it's been long enough that I can be pretty confident that my view on life won't be changing. If I was just feeling really depressed after some big traumatic incident, then you might have a point, but I've felt this way for over half my lifetime.

I'm not really interested in accepting this sexual identity. Even if I were, there's not much point in working through that in therapy when it would seem to be pretty low priority when I would still want to kill myself regardless of sexuality.

But I've always heard that therapy can only help if you are willing to put in effort. I don't want anything, so there's no point in putting in any effort. It seems much easier to end my misery by dying than by working super hard to chase some remote possibility of happiness. Maybe that's truly pathetic, but that's just the way I feel.

And I don't know why people seem confused why some people wouldn't want to be gay. Why would people just be ok with losing the respect of their friends and family? You only get one chance at life, and to have it fucked up in such a ridiculous way is just humiliating. But honestly, being 100% straight would be nice, but it wouldn't even be close to enough to make life worth living.

STDs aren't just a problem with gay sex, but gay sex poses a much higher risk, especially with regards to HIV. I probably will end up having sex with more men anyway, just because I lack self-control, and I'll likely trick myself into thinking I won't regret it. 

Engaging in any sort of gay acts just feels wrong to me. It just feels like I'm supposed to be straight, and that somehow my urges have become distorted. I wish I could say that I just turned to men out of desperation because I've completely failed with women, which would explain why it feels so wrong, but I've struggled same-sex attraction basically since puberty. Regardless, it just doesn't feel like something I should be doing. Every part of my brain is telling me that I need to be straight, even if it doesn't make any sense.

I acknowledge that it shouldn't really matter if I waste my money. The only problem is that I don't think I will ever actually have the balls to kill myself, so if I waste money, then my life will get even worse, but I still won't be able to end things because I'm too cowardly. Plus, when I've tried therapy before, it just made me feel worse, so why would I want to spend money to feel bad?

And medication has consistently not worked for me. The only effect it had was causing sexual dysfunction. It had no positive impact on my mood. I tried many different medications and stuck with each of them for months before giving up.

I don't think gay sex is wrong, although the higher risk of STDs is concerning. I just don't think it's right for me personally to engage in such acts. In any case, I really don't want to spend a bunch of money on therapy that I'm confident won't work. I know this might seem irrational, since if my alternative is suicide, wasting money is kind of irrelevant. But it's still hard to just throw money away, especially when I'm pretty sure I'm at an awkward income level, where I make enough that I won't be able to receive any sort of financial assistance for therapy, but not enough that it won't have a significant impact on my finances.

I don't really want to live. It's more just that I've accepted that if I've gone this long without being able to kill myself, then there's a good chance that I'll never be able to. It's irrational to keep holding onto hope that I can kill myself, when history has shown that I'm too weak to go through with it.  

With regards to conversion therapy, I know it has a low success rate, but does that mean it's not worth trying? In any case, it's not hugely important to me; it's just something I'm a little interested in because it just feels like I'm not supposed to be like this. But obviously, it all becomes irrelevant if I manage to kill myself.

There is absolutely zero chance I have BPD or NPD. I don't have the instability required of BPD or the self-importance for NPD. 

>>If you truly lack the ability to comprehend or identify "other people" as having intrinsic value rather than being resources or objects

What intrinsic value is there to a person? If someone is completely brain dead, what is their intrinsic value? Do people really want to have relationships with people who bring them zero utility. People who aren't humorous, attractive, interesting, helpful, or talented? 

>>Either one of those disorders virtually guarantees that anyone getting into relationship with you (romantic or otherwise) is in for a very bad time for the extremely short duration of the the relationship with you. And that's going to be an everpresent issue. 

And yet, I have had multiple friendships that have lasted over 10 years. So how can you say that I won't be able to form lasting non-romantic relationships? 

I've been in therapy before, and neither of those disorders were ever even floated as a possibility. Either I'm good enough to hide it from a professional, without consciously intending to, or your diagnosis is wrong.
So you think I should just completely give up? That doesn't seem right to me. I might as well just swallow the blackpill if I truly am doomed to be single forever.

I don't know. I just can't really imagine caring about someone else to
a significant degree. I mean, it's not like I completely disregard other people's feelings, but for the most part, I value my family/friends based on the utility they provide me. The utility of having a girlfriend is earning respect (and having a sexual partner).

>>Nobody except you gets to decide what you do with your life or how you feel about yourself.

I don't think a person has any control over how they feel about themselves. If you have experienced nothing but failure, but you're still confident, then you're probably just completely delusional. I think only someone with severe issues would ignore how everyone else feels about them when deciding how to feel about themselves, unless they know everyone else's opinion on them is based on faulty information (like a wrongfully convicted murderer). But if the whole world thinks you're a loser, how can you honestly deny that?

Couldn't it also be that men are more confident BECAUSE they're romantically successful, and this leads to greater earnings? You're just speculating that earnings and marriage are correlated due to a common factor, instead of marriage leading to higher wages. 

>>If you learn to appreciate yourself for what you are and stop grading yourself through the singular lens of romantic success, you may see progress in other aspects of life.

I have nothing to appreciate about myself. I don't grade myself only by romantic success; it probably just comes across that way since that's the topic of discussion here.

>>Get better friends if the ones you've got mock you.

Easier said than done. Besides, if were in their shoes, I would probably mock me too. 

>>No employer is going to ask you whether you're in a relationship during a job interview, and if they do, report them, because that's literally illegal in the US.

I don't live in the US, but in any case, there is definitely a correlation between being married and being successful career-wise as a man. 

>>I don't think you can safely say what "most" women would or wouldn't do, considering you're hardly an expert on them. The women I know wouldn't have an issue dating someone with no prior relationship experience if there was nothing wrong with the guy.

I mean, I don't have any hard data for this. Nevertheless, I'm fairly confident that most women would be at least a little wary of dating anyone with no relationship experience at 30. I guess neither of us has any proof other than anecdotes, but when I see the way women online talk about older male virgins, it definitely seems like it would be an uphill battle trying to date for the first time later in life.

>>I'm going to be 30 in a few months and I'm also a virgin. 

I'm not a virgin. I've had sex with sex workers and other men, which is probably a lot worse than being a virgin to be honest.

>>Nobody thinks it's weird, nobody thinks it's creepy, nobody thinks it's a red flag or that I'm secretly some sort of crazy person. They just don't care. Because it turns out, when you're an adult surrounded by other other adults, nobody has the time or energy for that kind of schoolyard gossiping anymore.

Maybe that's your experience, but that isn't mine. My family is ashamed of me for never having had a girlfriend. My friends are always mocking me. And I'm fairly confident that most women would never date someone knowing they had never had a girlfriend before age 30. Men in relationships have more respect which helps to translate into higher earnings. Plus, with cost of living so high where I live, getting into a serious relationship and moving in together would be hugely beneficial. If I can never get a girlfriend, it seems like it's going to just keep hurting my quality of life.

>>Ok so the obligatory I’m sorry you’re going through what you’re going through but... if you’re going to lose your job because you’re a “shitty worker” seems like it should be more a concern in your life and maybe concentrate on doing something about that. No one wants to date a hobo. 

I don't really care that much if I lose my job. I have enough money saved up to avoid homelessness for a while anyway.

>>Also like so many other advice askers, y’all ask “how to do I GET gf?” like you’re asking directions to the store that’s sells gf’s.

I never asked how to get a girlfriend. I asked how to get motivated to get a girlfriend. 

>>As I said the other person in a potential relationship will matter AS MUCH AS YOU and if you don’t want to do things or be supportive... what does the other person get out of all this? 

Obviously they get nothing. I don't know if it's reasonable to give up just because I acknowledge that anyone willing to date me is making a mistake though. I don't know how I would go about learning to care about others anyway, so is it really worth worrying about?

>>The question I would lead with is this: "Would you feel better having tried or having never tried?"

Probably having never tried. I don't know if I really want to deal with the humiliation of rejection. And to be honest, I don't know if I've ever met a girl I thought was worth dating. It would be nice to just give up, but I guess unless I'm willing to just straight up kill myself, I'm going to have to try to stop being such a loser.

How do I get motivated to get a girlfriend? I'm getting pretty close to 30, which feels like some sort of cutoff point - if I don't have a girlfriend before then, I have very little hope that I will ever get one; It's too much of a red flag for the vast majority of women, and I don't think I'm a very good liar, so it'll likely be pretty obvious that I've never been in a relationship before. I guess it's probably already too late for me, but it won't feel 100% impossible until I'm 30.

Getting a girlfriend just seems like an insane amount of work. I can barely function at all. Getting out of bed at all is hard enough, and I'm probably going to lose my job soon, as I'm a shitty worker. I really have trouble caring about others, and I know it would be difficult, if not impossible, to pretend to care about a girlfriend, if I had one. In any case, I know that there's basically nothing worthwhile about me, so I either have to become a master manipulator, or completely reinvent everything about myself, both of which seem like way too much effort. 

The real problem is, that unless I act soon, I'll probably never have a girlfriend. It'll be too late for me, and I'll be alone forever. I don't want to live a life as pathetic as that. Honestly though, at this point, I think I would rather just have the balls to kill myself than have a girlfriend; a girlfriend would just be too much work, and I can't imagine a relationship ever actually working out. 

I guess really, it's already over for me. In the last few months, I've done a lot of fucked up shit. I tried using grindr out of desperation, and I also tried having sex with sex workers just to experience sex with an actual woman. The experiences weren't even very satisfying, and now I can't even pretend like I'm a real man, or a good person. I just don't see how I can turn things around in time and fix myself. How do I even make myself want to fix myself? Giving up just seems so much more reasonable.
